stories.title: Trump orders Lake Ontario renamed Lake America in Canada dispute
new_facts: Trump signed executive order renaming Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' effective immediately.

stories.title: Glacial lake burst in Nepal kills hundreds; rescuers search for missing foreigners

stories.line: A glacial lake burst in Nepal and Tibet killed hundreds; rescue efforts ongoing with Americans and other foreigners among the missing.

stories.title: UEFA pursues criminal case against Infantino over World Cup sale plan
new_facts: First report UEFA is preparing a criminal complaint against Infantino over failed World Cup investor plan.

Names Joshua Kushner's Thrive Capital, $4.2bn deal price, and quotes UEFA lawyers calling it fraudulently off-market.
UEFA seeking documents from Kushner's investment firm.
UEFA asked a US court for FIFA documents and has suspended a boycott threat.
States UEFA pursuing criminal proceedings against both FIFA and Infantino, not just Infantino personally.
Frames UEFA's action as part of a broader campaign to oust Infantino as FIFA president.
Names the plan as the 'Fifa Forward Enterprise' plan and details separate US applications for documents on its conception.
Saudi Arabia's football federation publicly backs Infantino amid the FIFA crisis.
stories.line: UEFA is pursuing criminal charges against FIFA president Infantino over a failed World Cup sale scheme, while support fractures among member nations.
